content.title: Personal Device State Switch | Ordinary World to Private Performance
content.summary: Establish one clearly adult original subject, one personal device and an ordinary environment baseline. Use one visible device-wear or activation action as the sole switch into the heightened state. Change performance, camera rhythm and bounded environmental accents while preserving identity and geography. Keep surrounding public behavior plausible so the private state remains legible by contrast. Return camera and subject motion to a stable baseline in the same environment, with device state visibly resolved.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject, one personal device and an ordinary environment baseline. + Use one visible device-wear or activation action as the sole switch into the heightened state. + Change performance, camera rhythm and bounded environmental accents while preserving identity and geography. + Keep surrounding public behavior plausible so the private state remains legible by contrast. + Return camera and subject motion to a stable baseline in the same environment, with device state visibly resolved.
quick_start.recommended_input: On an original early-morning ferry terminal, establish one clearly adult South Asian commuter in a moss coat holding a small brass pocket metronome; crowds walk normally behind her. Her next four steps align with restrained amber floor reflections and one foreground post wipe; keep the same terminal, face, coat and surrounding pedestrian routes. She closes the metronome; light bands stop, the camera settles and the same adult resumes a normal walk in the unchanged terminal. Hold without text or brand.
